FIELDS.NAME: ClearVision Optical Services
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Quality Assurance Manager, ClearVision Optical Services, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@clearvisionoptical.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At ClearVision Optical Services, we specialize in the retail sale of high-quality optical frames, lenses, and accessories, providing our customers with a comprehensive range of eyewear solutions. Our operations primarily focus on serving the local community, ensuring accessibility to vision care products. We offer in-house services that include lens edging and minor frame repairs, strictly adhering to industry safety standards to mitigate manufacturing risks. All our staff involved in optical fitting and dispensing are fully licensed and trained, ensuring customers receive expert service and precise fittings. We have established documented quality assurance protocols and employee training programs to maintain high service standards and compliance with regulations. We also implement a robust inventory management system to track our inventory and minimize loss, ensuring our customers benefit from a wide selection of products without compromising quality.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: ClearVision Eye Accessories LLC, 456 Vision Lane, Springfield, IL 62704-5678, specializes in the sale of custom eyewear accessories, including cases, cleaning solutions, and lens protectors, complementing the core optical retail operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2022, we experienced a theft incident where optical lenses and frames valued at $1,200 were stolen from our inventory. The incident was reported to local authorities, and the recovery status is ongoing with no items recovered to date.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed Security Safe.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured facility with 24/7 video surveillance and regular security patrols.

Our activities are focused on retail sales and limited in-house services such as lens edging and minor frame repairs, adhering to safety standards.

Our operations are conducted with integrity and compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – ClearVision Optical Services has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Our insurance history remains solid and without any issues.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – ClearVision Optical Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and protection for our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – ClearVision Optical Services also owns and operates ClearVision Eye Accessories LLC, which specializes in the sale of custom eyewear accessories, complementing our core optical retail operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – ClearVision Optical Services does not currently have any other insurance with this company. We only hold the policy listed for our primary operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – ClearVision Optical Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products beyond the incidental in-house services of lens edging and minor frame repairs, which adhere to safety standards. Our primary operations focus on retail sales of optical frames, lenses, and accessories.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – ClearVision Optical Services does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is solely on retail sales and in-house optical services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – ClearVision Optical Services has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The financial standing of the business remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – ClearVision Optical Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations primarily focus on retail optical services and minor in-house repairs, adhering to all necessary safety standards.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – ClearVision Optical Services does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on retail sales and in-house services that comply with safety standards. We have not experienced any significant natural disasters or incidents affecting our business continuity.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – ClearVision Optical Services has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our commitment to compliance and ethical practices ensures a safe and respectful environment for all.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – ClearVision Optical Services currently does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety regulations.
